nodes.description: Public mapping balanceOf(address=>uint) holding token balances of the walrus token.
Public nested mapping allowance(address=>address=>uint) of spending approvals.
Public uint totalSupply of the walrus token.
Public string name of the token.
Public string symbol of the token.
Public constant uint decimals = 18.
Private address owner, the privileged deployer account.
Private address owner2 privileged account hardcoded in constructor.
Private address owner3 privileged account hardcoded in constructor.
Private address owner4 privileged account hardcoded in constructor.
Private address owner5 privileged account hardcoded in constructor.
Private address owner6 privileged account hardcoded in constructor.
Constant internal address UNI (Uniswap V2 router) used as approved spender in the constructor.
transfer(address,uint) payable; forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
transferFrom(address,uint) payable with ensure modifier; adjusts allowance and balances without SafeMath.
approve(address,uint) payable; writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
delegate(address,bytes) payable; owner-gated arbitrary delegatecall to attacker-supplied address and calldata.
batchSend(address[],uint) payable; owner-gated loop crediting balances with unchecked multiplication/subtraction.
Internal pure Uniswap-V2-style pair address derivation using keccak256 and hardcoded init code hash.
ensure(address,address) modifier; computes pair via pairFor and restricts transfers to owner/owner2..owner6/UNI.
Constructor(string,string,uint256) payable; sets metadata, owner accounts and initial supply/allowance.
msg.sender, externally controlled caller used for authorization checks and balance/allowance accounting.
Low-level a.delegatecall(b) on a user-supplied address with user-supplied calldata, allowing arbitrary storage mutation / full takeover if any owner account is compromised.
Unchecked arithmetic in batchSend: total = _value * _tos.length and balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total can overflow/underflow (no SafeMath).
Unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom: allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value, balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value without SafeMath.
